author: XBloodyRuckerX
body: Dear players of the Avicus network. I was recently banned for "cursing". The time given that I was on would be impossible for me to be on, due to family engagements. I have had problems with another player using my account in the past, but have taken the necessary steps into stopping this threw changing my password. I love playing on your server and hope that you over turn by ban.
